Jules: include columns: customer, ask, severity(low/med/high), renewal_risk(yes/no/unclear), quote, contact, triage(doc/eng/ops), eta(days/weeks).

- Finch: wants per-route cost export for finance -> med, unclear, ask: billing export
- Kubo: importer fails on mixed newline types, returns 400; workaround manual reformat -> med, renewal not mentioned
Jules: I'll add enablement recs for Finch (docs-first) and a quick repro for Kubo to help eng estimate.
triage-bot: Reminder: product triage 10am PT tomorrow. Add consolidated rows to backlog pre-read.
Marco: uploaded CSV: <drive/link>  3 rows, added impact scores (Solace=5, Finch=3, Kubo=3). quotes + call_ts included.

product: received  will review before sync and tag any items that affect renewals.
